verdict.rationale: The evidence shows sellers can be onboarded through hosted or API-only flows, with Adyen verifying them 'before paying out'. That loosely implies a seller can start before full verification completes, with verification gating payouts. Nothing documents tunable or tiered requirement collection, payout-volume thresholds that trigger more data, or per-seller requirements-due states. Missing for 10: configurable minimum-to-start vs. later-collection tiers, threshold-based requirement escalation, per-seller requirements/verification-due status visibility, independent corroboration.
